text.text_excerpt: Wow! What an awesome experience! I have to say, the space was much smaller than I anticipated but a beautiful and smart use of space, none the less! We pre dined here on our way to the Saenger. Within walking distance. I wish I had a cocktail menu to reference because those were amazing! We were a group of four with me arriving early. I was seated promptly and they do incomplete party seating, which was cool. Cozy table in the corner, banquette seating with tons of pillows. Super comfy. Host was engaging, smiling, accommodating. Everything she should be. Jean, our server, was over the top enthusiastic. This guy.... LOVES his job and knows his stuff. He was full of information and delivere...

I like this place. They had just opened a few weeks back and I was looking for a good burger. The burger did not disappoint. Any place that gives me double patties cooked a perfect medium rare without asking is okay in my book. I wish it was a bit messier though. I tried to order a half order of chicken, which apparently is not possible. So I had a few bites and took the rest back to eat for breakfast. It was a tasty chicken but I would likely try something else the next time. The dessert tasted good but beware, it is fancy schmancy. This place is in a hotel and it had style. I'm not sure why others had issues with the proximity to the hotel. It has plenty of separation. The staff went ab...

This is a really cute restaurant in the Troubadour hotel. I got the crab omelet and a soy iced latte. The iced latte was one of the best that I had in Nola. The omelet was done well but the flavors were just too unique for me. The egg was so nice and fluffy and the crab was plentiful and fresh. My only complaint is the lemon jus that it is served with. It just felt like an odd pairing with the omelet but I could see how others would enjoy it. Service was not bad and overall a nice breakfast. Would recommend it if you don't want to venture too far from your hotel.
